<EndpointMetadata metadata={{"method":"get","path":"/rest/api/v1/actions/actionpack/{actionPackId}/auth","api":"client","release":{"stage":"ga"},"authorization":{"schemes":["APIToken"],"header":"Authorization: Bearer <token>","tokenTypes":["OAuth access token","Glean-issued token"],"docsUrl":"/api-info/client/authentication/overview"},"scopes":null,"deprecations":[]}} />



Reports whether the calling user is already authenticated against the third-party
tool backing the specified action pack. Intended for headless / server-driven clients
that render an "Authorize" prompt when the user has not yet consented to the tool.
